*🧭 Market picture*
USD & majors:
The DXY is rangebound at 101.92 (+0.04%) ahead of the US midterms following the Federal Reserve holding interest rates steady. USD/JPY sits at 157.78 (-0.02%) after the Bank of Japan held rates at 1.25% while hinting at a December hike. EUR/USD trades at 1.1173 (-0.09%) amid French bond and inflation risks, while GBP/USD stands at 1.3390 (+0.08%) with the Bank of England poised to raise rates.

Gold:
Gold gained +0.60% to 3,922.1 as dip buyers emerged and Iran risks persist.

Oil:
Brent dropped -5.60% to 111.05 and WTI declined -2.34% to 101.68 ahead of US midterms, despite OPEC+ holding December output targets unchanged.

Risk mood:
Risk sentiment retreated as the S&P 500 fell -1.82% to 7,580, the VIX jumped +12.91% to 19.42, and the US 10-year yield slipped -1.20% to 4.929%.

Political risk:
Hormuz attacks and Ukraine resuming refinery strikes threaten oil supplies and channel heightened volatility directly into energy benchmarks.

Watch today:
- US ISM Manufacturing PMI (Mon 08:45 PM NPT, exp. 54.5, prev. 54.5)
- US midterm election developments
- Hormuz security and Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries
